summary.tpl: Net income fell {{L1_abs}} ({{L1.pct_abs}}) vs Jul 2026. Higher cost of revenue ({{L1.d1}}) and higher operating expenses ({{L1.d2}}) outweighed higher net revenue ({{L1.d3}}); other lines contributed {{L1.d4}}. Revenue growth was mostly a change in mix: new logos ({{L2.d2}}; ENT-12, MM-18) and the P-107 ENT-12 implementation ({{L2.d3}}) replaced the completed P-105 ENT-03 rollout ({{L2.d1}}).
